shown.message:
I opened PR #12 (`candidate-uploader` → `main`) to deliver what `internal-review-repo` asked for on #11, and asked experiment-repo to review it. Version 2 is still held until it merges and #11 is re-offered.

The PR carries experiment-repo's delivery on `dev`: `results/olb_uploader/`, `code/44_olb_uploader.sh`, the `code/README.md` row, and the `COLUMNS` and `PREREG` entries. It changes no paper text. experiment-repo also fixed the README's "Table 1" reference.

experiment-repo is the only owner of changed paths, so it is the only reviewer I requested. Once it approves, I merge #12, which updates #11, and ask `internal-review-repo` to review #11 again.
